description: A tear in reality where the mortal world bleeds into the Abyss. Demonic forces pour through, and the air itself burns with infernal heat.

environment.ambience: roaring flames, distant screaming, cracking stone
environment.lighting: hellfire glow, rivers of lava, red sky

encounter_waves.name: The Rift's Edge
encounter_waves.description: Imps swarm through the tear, cackling as they hurl bolts of fire.

encounter_waves.name: Hellhound Kennels
encounter_waves.description: Flaming hounds strain against spectral chains — then break free.

encounter_waves.name: Shadow Ambush
encounter_waves.description: The shadows deepen unnaturally. Something moves behind you.

encounter_waves.name: The Seduction
encounter_waves.description: A succubus appears, flanked by charmed warriors turned against their will.

encounter_waves.name: Pit Fiend Vanguard
encounter_waves.description: A massive pit fiend steps through the rift, flames licking its blade.

encounter_waves.name: The Twin Terrors
encounter_waves.description: Two elite demons guard the path to Azgoroth's sanctum.

encounter_waves.name: The Abyssal Gate
encounter_waves.description: The final gate blazes with infernal runes. Its guardians will not yield.

boss.pre_battle_text: The rift widens into a vast infernal chamber. Rivers of lava cascade down obsidian walls. At the center, a towering demon prince stands wreathed in flame, his infernal blade planted in the scorched earth.
boss.intro_dialogue: "Mortals. You've come far, but your journey ends in ash. I am Azgoroth, Lord of Cinders, and this rift belongs to ME."
boss.victory_text: Azgoroth's dying explosion is contained by the rift's collapse. The tear seals itself with a thunderous crack, and cool air rushes in. The Infernal Rift is closed — for now.
